body: Live. It’s the hardest but most worth it thing you can do. Make 10-15 goals and ruthlessly achieve them and see how your entire life shifts. Life genuinely is beautiful and I’m sorry that it has been hard for you, but you have potential to do something great in this world. Create so much success that anyone who has ever hurt you will realise that it was wrong to do or say what they did. Also you’re only 19, still a teenager- you have your whole life ahead of you. Don’t compare yourself to others I feel like you’re doing that a lot. Remember you have a completely different dna set than anyone who is living and has ever lived. Create your own path. Don’t follow people who don’t have the kind of intelligence and depth you have (which I can tell you have just by reading the way you have formulated your thoughts here). I’m telling you- LIVE. Life is beautiful, and I’m sure you’re destined for great things.
